version_method: One complete current body per original path, fixed by source SHA256; distinct paths/failed routes and duplicate aliases remain distinct entries.
old_git_versions: Older Git-only body versions have not been migrated in this edition; history metadata inventory is not publication.
correction_policy: Keep historical wrong/rejected bodies. Keyword roles are archival hints, not a scientific judgment or fabricated CRL revision edge.
known_limits: Original notes preserve observation, coefficient, collar, variance, gcd and Gram routes with their counterexamples and unresolved arithmetic gates. Ordinary Mobius and Lambda-minus-one cancellation over all starts/prefixes and the signed arithmetic Gram are not certified. Fixed-weight/fixed-filter assumptions and later scope challenges remain material limitations.
